notes.title: Tree Simulator 2.0 - Demo is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We are putting all our energy into our main project, Tree Simulator 2.0 demo is now playable on Steam! 

What to expect in the demo:
✔️ Explore a open world
✔️ Be a tree
✔️ Oscar the baby is now findable
✔️ Find some guilty squirrels
✔️ Make tasks and get skins and other stuff
✔️ and more

This is just the beginning!
The demo gives you a first taste of the game, but there’s much more to come! Your feedback is very important and helps us to impro[url=https://discord.com/invite/M6mVMfFVpF]Discord[/url]ve the game even further.

Try the demo and share your thoughts!
Give the demo a try and let us know what you think! You can share your feedback directly on Steam or in our Discord.

🌱🌱🌱Have fun exploring! 🌱🌱🌱
